##########################################################################
# Eire Reborn - Update 2 effects (generated by tools/gen_script_v8.py)
##########################################################################

# Picks the Black Host's warlord: a Norse AI ruler, the bigger the likelier. root = the defender.
# Saves scope:eir_bh_lord and scope:eir_target_county (a coastal county of the realm).
eir_bh_pick_effect = {
	random_ruler = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			is_ruler = yes
			highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county
			culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_north_germanic }
			NOT = { has_truce = root }
			NOT = { this = root }
		}
		weight = {
			base = 1
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				highest_held_title_tier >= tier_duchy
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 20
				highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				max_military_strength >= 3000
			}
		}
		save_scope_as = eir_bh_lord
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_realm_county = { is_coastal_county = yes }
		}
		random_realm_county = {
			limit = { is_coastal_county = yes }
			save_scope_as = eir_target_county
		}
	}
	else = {
		capital_county ?= { save_scope_as = eir_target_county }
	}
}

# Wave 1 of the Black Host. Expects root = the defender, scope:eir_bh_lord and scope:eir_target_county.
eir_bh_landing_1_effect = {
	save_scope_as = eir_defender
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:eir_bh_lord
			exists = scope:eir_target_county
			exists = scope:eir_target_county.holder
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = eir_bh_lord_var
			value = scope:eir_bh_lord
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = eir_bh_county_var
			value = scope:eir_target_county
		}
		scope:eir_bh_lord = {
			set_variable = {
				name = eir_bh_raider
				value = 1
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = eir_viking_target
				value = scope:eir_target_county
			}
			add_character_modifier = {
				modifier = eir_black_host_modifier
				years = 4
			}
			add_pressed_claim = scope:eir_target_county
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:eir_defender = { eir_realm_size_trigger = { N = 20 } }
				}
				spawn_army = {
					levies = 6500
					men_at_arms = {
						type = light_footmen
						stacks = 6
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = armored_footmen
						stacks = 8
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = huscarl
						stacks = 4
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = bowmen
						stacks = 4
					}
					location = scope:eir_target_county.title_province
					origin = scope:eir_bh_lord.capital_province
					inheritable = no
					uses_supply = no
					name = eir_bh_wave1_name
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					scope:eir_defender = { eir_realm_size_trigger = { N = 10 } }
				}
				spawn_army = {
					levies = 4500
					men_at_arms = {
						type = light_footmen
						stacks = 5
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = armored_footmen
						stacks = 6
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = huscarl
						stacks = 3
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = bowmen
						stacks = 3
					}
					location = scope:eir_target_county.title_province
					origin = scope:eir_bh_lord.capital_province
					inheritable = no
					uses_supply = no
					name = eir_bh_wave1_name
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					scope:eir_defender = { eir_realm_size_trigger = { N = 4 } }
				}
				spawn_army = {
					levies = 3200
					men_at_arms = {
						type = light_footmen
						stacks = 4
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = armored_footmen
						stacks = 4
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = huscarl
						stacks = 2
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = bowmen
						stacks = 2
					}
					location = scope:eir_target_county.title_province
					origin = scope:eir_bh_lord.capital_province
					inheritable = no
					uses_supply = no
					name = eir_bh_wave1_name
				}
			}
			else = {
				spawn_army = {
					levies = 2200
					men_at_arms = {
						type = light_footmen
						stacks = 3
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = armored_footmen
						stacks = 3
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = huscarl
						stacks = 1
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = bowmen
						stacks = 2
					}
					location = scope:eir_target_county.title_province
					origin = scope:eir_bh_lord.capital_province
					inheritable = no
					uses_supply = no
					name = eir_bh_wave1_name
				}
			}
			add_character_flag = temp_no_claim_war_cost
			start_war = {
				cb = claim_cb
				target = scope:eir_target_county.holder
				claimant = scope:eir_bh_lord
				target_title = scope:eir_target_county
			}
			remove_character_flag = temp_no_claim_war_cost
		}
	}
}

# Wave 2 of the Black Host. Expects root = the defender, scope:eir_bh_lord and scope:eir_target_county.
eir_bh_landing_2_effect = {
	save_scope_as = eir_defender
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:eir_bh_lord
			exists = scope:eir_target_county
			exists = scope:eir_target_county.holder
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = eir_bh_lord_var
			value = scope:eir_bh_lord
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = eir_bh_county_var
			value = scope:eir_target_county
		}
		scope:eir_bh_lord = {
			set_variable = {
				name = eir_bh_raider
				value = 2
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = eir_viking_target
				value = scope:eir_target_county
			}
			add_character_modifier = {
				modifier = eir_black_host_modifier
				years = 4
			}
			add_pressed_claim = scope:eir_target_county
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:eir_defender = { eir_realm_size_trigger = { N = 20 } }
				}
				spawn_army = {
					levies = 6000
					men_at_arms = {
						type = light_footmen
						stacks = 6
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = armored_footmen
						stacks = 7
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = huscarl
						stacks = 4
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = bowmen
						stacks = 4
					}
					location = scope:eir_target_county.title_province
					origin = scope:eir_bh_lord.capital_province
					inheritable = no
					uses_supply = no
					name = eir_bh_wave2_name
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					scope:eir_defender = { eir_realm_size_trigger = { N = 10 } }
				}
				spawn_army = {
					levies = 4000
					men_at_arms = {
						type = light_footmen
						stacks = 5
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = armored_footmen
						stacks = 5
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = huscarl
						stacks = 3
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = bowmen
						stacks = 3
					}
					location = scope:eir_target_county.title_province
					origin = scope:eir_bh_lord.capital_province
					inheritable = no
					uses_supply = no
					name = eir_bh_wave2_name
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					scope:eir_defender = { eir_realm_size_trigger = { N = 4 } }
				}
				spawn_army = {
					levies = 2800
					men_at_arms = {
						type = light_footmen
						stacks = 4
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = armored_footmen
						stacks = 3
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = huscarl
						stacks = 2
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = bowmen
						stacks = 3
					}
					location = scope:eir_target_county.title_province
					origin = scope:eir_bh_lord.capital_province
					inheritable = no
					uses_supply = no
					name = eir_bh_wave2_name
				}
			}
			else = {
				spawn_army = {
					levies = 1800
					men_at_arms = {
						type = light_footmen
						stacks = 3
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = armored_footmen
						stacks = 2
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = huscarl
						stacks = 1
					}
					men_at_arms = {
						type = bowmen
						stacks = 2
					}
					location = scope:eir_target_county.title_province
					origin = scope:eir_bh_lord.capital_province
					inheritable = no
					uses_supply = no
					name = eir_bh_wave2_name
				}
			}
			add_character_flag = temp_no_claim_war_cost
			start_war = {
				cb = claim_cb
				target = scope:eir_target_county.holder
				claimant = scope:eir_bh_lord
				target_title = scope:eir_target_county

}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The outcome of a Black Host wave, called in the defender's scope (the player, or the player when a vassal fought).
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
eir_bh_wave_won_effect = {
	change_variable = {
		name = eir_bh_wins
		add = 1
	}
	trigger_event = eir.0420
}

eir_bh_wave_lost_effect = {
	change_variable = {
		name = eir_bh_losses
		add = 1
	}
	trigger_event = eir.0421
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Lesser invasions. Expects root = the defender, scope:eir_inv_lord and scope:eir_target_county.
# KIND: 1 Briton, 2 Alban Gael, 3 Irish rival, 5 Hebridean Norse. LEVIES / STACKS tune the host.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
eir_inv_launch_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:eir_inv_lord
			exists = scope:eir_target_county
			exists = scope:eir_target_county.holder
		}
		scope:eir_inv_lord = {
			set_variable = {
				name = eir_inv_kind
				value = $KIND$
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = eir_viking_target
				value = scope:eir_target_county
			}
			add_pressed_claim = scope:eir_target_county
			spawn_army = {
				levies = $LEVIES$
				men_at_arms = {
					type = light_footmen
					stacks = $STACKS$
				}
				men_at_arms = {
					type = armored_footmen
					stacks = $STACKS$
				}
				location = scope:eir_target_county.title_province
				origin = capital_province
				inheritable = no
				uses_supply = no
				name = $NAME$
			}
			add_character_flag = temp_no_claim_war_cost
			start_war = {
				cb = claim_cb
				target = scope:eir_target_county.holder
				claimant = scope:eir_inv_lord
				target_title = scope:eir_target_county
			}
			remove_character_flag = temp_no_claim_war_cost
		}
	}
}

# A Briton (Welsh, Cornish, Cumbrian or Breton) AI ruler and a coastal county. root = defender.
eir_pick_briton_invader_effect = {
	random_ruler = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			is_ruler = yes
			highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county
			culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_brythonic }
			NOT = { has_truce = root }
			NOT = { this = root }
		}
		save_scope_as = eir_inv_lord
	}
	eir_pick_target_county_effect = yes
}

# An Alban Gael (Goidelic, not Irish) AI ruler.
eir_pick_alban_invader_effect = {
	random_ruler = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			is_ruler = yes
			highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county
			culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_goidelic }
			NOT = { culture = culture:irish }
			NOT = { has_truce = root }
			NOT = { this = root }
		}
		save_scope_as = eir_inv_lord
	}
	eir_pick_target_county_effect = yes
}

# An independent Irish AI king who is not the defender.
eir_pick_rival_king_effect = {
	random_ruler = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			is_ruler = yes
			is_independent_ruler = yes
			highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county
			culture = culture:irish
			NOT = { has_truce = root }
			NOT = { this = root }
		}
		save_scope_as = eir_inv_lord
	}
	eir_pick_target_county_effect = yes
}

# A Norse-Gaelic or Norse AI ruler for the small Hebridean-style raids.
eir_pick_isles_raider_effect = {
	random_ruler = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			is_ruler = yes
			highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county
			highest_held_title_tier <= tier_duchy
			culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_north_germanic }
			NOT = { has_truce = root }
			NOT = { this = root }
		}
		save_scope_as = eir_inv_lord
	}
	eir_pick_target_county_effect = yes
}

eir_pick_target_county_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_realm_county = { is_coastal_county = yes }
		}
		random_realm_county = {
			limit = { is_coastal_county = yes }
			save_scope_as = eir_target_county
		}
	}
	else = {
		capital_county ?= { save_scope_as = eir_target_county }
	}
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Conquest, culture and triumph helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Converts one county held by the realm that has a foreign culture (Britain or Norse) to the ruler's culture,
# remembering it in scope:eir_conv_county. Used by colonists, the Ostmen decision and triumphs.
eir_convert_one_county_effect = {
	random_sub_realm_county = {
		limit = { eir_foreign_conquest_county_trigger = yes }
		save_scope_as = eir_conv_county
		set_county_culture = root.culture
	}
}

# A triumph: every foreign-held county of the realm gets a short-lived triumph modifier, vassals are impressed,
# and the world notices.
eir_triumph_glory_effect = {
	every_sub_realm_county = {
		limit = { eir_foreign_conquest_county_trigger = yes }
		add_county_modifier = {
			modifier = eir_triumph_county_modifier
			years = 10
		}
	}
	eir_vassal_opinion_effect = { MODIFIER = eir_triumph_opinion OPINION = 8 }
}

# Burns the Norse grip on the realm: removes danegeld modifiers and the flag.
eir_end_danegeld_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = eir_danegeld_modifier }
		remove_character_modifier = eir_danegeld_modifier
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_flag = eir_paid_danegeld }
		remove_character_flag = eir_paid_danegeld
	}
}

# The colony stored in var:eir_colony_county takes the ruler's culture.
eir_colony_convert_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = eir_colony_county }
		var:eir_colony_county ?= {
			set_county_culture = root.culture
			add_county_modifier = {
				modifier = eir_hedge_schools_modifier
				years = 15
			}
		}
		remove_variable = eir_colony_county
	}
}
